note.en: The reference splits on `|`, not on `:`: it renders `中国:zhōng` as the base text with `guó` as ruby text, while this package splits the base per character and pairs `中`/`zhōng` and `国`/`guó`.
note.zh: 参考包按 `|` 而不是 `:` 分割：它把 `中国:zhōng` 渲染为 base 文本、把 `guó` 渲染为 ruby 文本，而本包按字符拆分 base，并配对 `中`/`zhōng` 与 `国`/`guó`。

note.en: This package does not recognize the upstream `|` divider, so it leaves the construct as plain text; the reference renders it as ruby.
note.zh: 本包不识别上游的 `|` 分隔符，因此将该结构保留为纯文本；参考包会将其渲染为 ruby。

note.en: Same divider difference: this package renders ruby, the reference leaves the text untouched.
note.zh: 同样的分隔符差异：本包渲染 ruby，参考包保持文本不变。

note.en: Divider difference: this package splits per character into two `<rt>` pairs, while the reference does not recognize `:` as the divider.
note.zh: 分隔符差异：本包按字符拆分成两对 `<rt>`，而参考包不把 `:` 识别为分隔符。

note.en: Divider difference inside emphasis; both sides keep the surrounding `**` markup.
note.zh: 强调内部的同一分隔符差异；双方都保留外层的 `**` 标记。

note.en: Divider difference: this package parses inline markup inside the base text, the reference leaves the whole construct as text with the emphasis parsed normally.
note.zh: 分隔符差异：本包会解析 base 文本内部的行内标记，参考包则把整个结构当作文本，并正常解析其中的强调。

note.en: Divider difference: this package parses inline markup inside the ruby text, the reference leaves the construct as text.
note.zh: 分隔符差异：本包会解析 ruby 文本内部的行内标记，参考包则把该结构当作文本。

note.en: This package rejects empty `|`-separated segments and leaves the source as text; the reference sees no `:` divider, treats `ab:` as base text and renders an empty `<rt></rt>`.
note.zh: 本包拒绝空的 `|` 分隔段并保留源文本；参考包看不到 `:` 分隔符，把 `ab:` 当作 base 文本，并渲染空的 `<rt></rt>`。

note.en: This package keeps everything after the first `:` as ruby text; the reference does not recognize `:` and leaves the source as text.
note.zh: 本包保留第一个 `:` 之后的所有内容作为 ruby 文本；参考包不识别 `:`，保留源文本。

note.en: This package treats `\\` as an escaped backslash and the following `:` as the divider; the reference does not parse `:` at all.
note.zh: 本包把 `\\` 视为转义反斜杠，并把其后的 `:` 作为分隔符；参考包完全不解析 `:`。

note.en: Divider difference: this package renders ruby inside the table cell, the reference keeps the source text.
note.zh: 分隔符差异：本包在表格单元格内渲染 ruby，参考包保留源文本。

notes.en: The current package and the installed reference use different dividers: this package implements `{ruby base:ruby text}` (the upstream syntax that the fork was based on), while the installed `markdown-it-ruby@1.1.2` implements DenDenMarkdown's `{ruby base|ruby text}`. This is a real behavioral difference, not a normalization, so every case that renders ruby on one side renders plain text on the other and carries a `note`.
notes.zh: 当前包与已安装的参考包使用不同的分隔符：本包实现 `{ruby base:ruby text}`（fork 所基于的上游语法），而已安装的 `markdown-it-ruby@1.1.2` 实现 DenDenMarkdown 的 `{ruby base|ruby text}`。这是真实的行为差异，不是归一化，因此每个在一侧渲染 ruby 的用例在另一侧都会渲染为纯文本，并带有 `note`。

notes.en: The reference has an `rp` option (`[open, close]`). This package does not implement it, so the reference is left at its default `rp: []`, which renders no `<rp>` elements and matches the current package's output shape.
notes.zh: 参考包有一个 `rp` 选项（`[open, close]`）。本包未实现它，因此参考包保持默认的 `rp: []`，不会渲染任何 `<rp>` 元素，与当前包的输出形状一致。

notes.en: The reference renders empty rubies such as `{ab:|}` (base `ab:`, empty `<rt></rt>`) because it only splits on `|`; this package rejects empty `|`-separated segments and empty ruby text, which is covered by `empty-ruby-segment`.
notes.zh: 参考包会渲染 `{ab:|}` 这类空 ruby（base 为 `ab:`，空的 `<rt></rt>`），因为它只按 `|` 分割；本包会拒绝空的 `|` 分隔段和空 ruby 文本，`empty-ruby-segment` 用例覆盖了这一点。

notes.en: Because the syntax differs, every benchmark corpus mixes both divider styles: each side parses its own syntax and only scans over the other side's lines. Throughput ratios therefore compare equivalent mixtures, not identical parse work.
notes.zh: 由于语法不同，每个基准语料都混合了两种分隔符风格：每一侧解析自己的语法，只是扫描另一侧的文本行。因此吞吐量比值比较的是等价的混合语料，而不是完全相同的解析工作量。

notes.en: `unmatched-openers` (an opening `{` with no divider and no closing brace at all) stays quadratic on both sides, because both scan forward to the end of the inline content. `dense-documented-syntax` is linear for this package but quadratic for the reference, and `upstream-syntax` is linear for this package because the fork now stops at the first closing brace before the divider.
notes.zh: `unmatched-openers`（只有开头 `{`，既没有分隔符也没有结束花括号）在双方都保持二次复杂度，因为双方都会向前扫描到行内内容末尾。`dense-documented-syntax` 对本包是线性、对参考包是二次，而 `upstream-syntax` 对本包是线性，因为 fork 现在会在分隔符之前的第一个结束花括号处停止。
